title: Warped Numerical Calabi-Yau Metrics
summary: We compute numerical warped Type IIB flux backgrounds on Calabi-Yau threefolds following the construction of Giddings, Kachru, and Polchinski. Using physics-informed neural networks, we approximate all three ingredients required by the GKP setup: the Ricci-flat Calabi-Yau metric, the harmonic (2,1)-forms representing the imaginary self-dual three-form flux, and the warp factor, which solves a sourced Poisson equation on the internal manifold.
